title: Risk prediction of sepsis-associated acute kidney injury: development, validation of a machine learning model with multicenter data.
summary: Using MIMIC-IV for development and two external ICU databases, XGBoost predicted sepsis-associated acute kidney injury with AUC 0.72 internally and 0.82/0.84 externally; differences across datasets and the retrospective design limit clinical interpretation.
ai_technology: Six machine-learning algorithms were optimized with grid search and five-fold cross-validation; XGBoost was selected and interpreted with SHAP.
organization: Guangxi Medical University; First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University

evidence.tested: The retrospective model used MIMIC-IV for development and eICU-CRD and BB-ICU for external assessment. XGBoost AUC was 0.72 internally and 0.82 and 0.84 externally; calibration and decision-curve analyses were also reported.
evidence.unknown: Performance and AKI incidence differed across data sources. Retrospective prediction does not establish causal benefit, prospective performance or clinical utility of the web calculator.
evidence.ai_role: Six machine-learning algorithms were optimized with grid search and five-fold cross-validation; XGBoost was selected and interpreted with SHAP.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
